rubric.role_summary: Director-level music editorial and curation role establishing editorial vision, curation frameworks, and music-discovery programs, while building a team and partnering with Product and Engineering.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Director-level music editorial and curation role establishing editorial vision, curation frameworks, and music-discovery programs, while building a team and partnering with Product and Engineering.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience in A&R, editorial, or a related field within the music industry.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a streaming, publication, or AI company.
- Familiarity specifically with music taxonomy or editorial curation systems.
- Experience working within or alongside product and engineering teams.
- Experience building and improving processes across marketing or editorial workflows.
- Familiarity with metadata and taxonomy systems.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area; Greater Los Angeles area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

soft_requirements: A point of view on music curation and discovery, including cultural authenticity.
AI fluency, or curiosity and fair review of music made with AI assistance.
Communication with senior artist teams, external partners, and internal colleagues.
Comfort with ambiguity, a hands-on approach, and enthusiasm for music and creative technology.
Ability to collaborate across rapidly growing teams.
Music taste, industry relationships, and awareness of how music moves online, as described for the ideal candidate.
